summary: The console implementation matches the saved plan: it adds persisted operator display preferences for light/dark theme, high contrast, and large font size; applies before-hydration HTML data attributes; provides keyboard-reachable accessible controls; adds dark/high-contrast/large-font CSS treatment; and includes unit plus Playwright browser coverage with desktop and mobile screenshots for dashboard, workspace details, logs, and merge queue. Console validation passed: npm test, npm test:browser, npm lint, npm typecheck, and npm build. Typecheck passed after clearing ignored stale .next/dev generated type output.
